# Pacific AI Tech

Pacific AI Tech is a local-first AI agent setup and automation consulting service for small operators across greater Portland and the Pacific Northwest.
Primary goal: help owners use Claude Cowork, Hermes Agent, and similar desktop agent stacks on their own computers without becoming technical operators.

## Start Here

- Book a setup call: https://calendar.app.google/LcubD3qcRnkpWqew6
- Contact Pacific AI Tech: mailto:hello@pacificaitech.com
- Service overview and pricing: https://www.pacificai.tech/#pricing
- What Pacific AI Tech installs and configures: https://www.pacificai.tech/#what-we-do
- Full model-readable service export: https://www.pacificai.tech/llms-full.txt

## Pricing And Offers

- In-person setup ($2,800 flat): one day on-site, ten automations, installation on the client's machine, training, a handoff cheat sheet, and 30-day premium support.
- Remote setup ($2,000 flat): two half-day screen-share sessions with the same ten-automation deliverable and 30-day premium support.
- Follow-up support ($100/hr): remote help for broken workflows, new automations, onboarding, and adjustments.
- Booking link for all plans: https://calendar.app.google/LcubD3qcRnkpWqew6

## Service Area

- Primary coverage: greater Portland and the Pacific Northwest.
- In-person cities include Portland, Vancouver, Beaverton, Hillsboro, Tigard, Lake Oswego, Gresham, Oregon City, Salem, Tualatin, McMinnville, and Olympia.
- Service radius: between Olympia and Salem, the coast and the Cascades, when practical by car.

## Best Fit Customers

- Real estate agents: listing-to-marketing workflows, comp pulls, lead follow-up, and weekend showing briefs.
- Restaurant owners: inventory reorder, menu translation, OpenTable digest, food-cost flags, and review response drafts.
- Solo founders: inbox triage, lead research, weekly investor updates, and meeting-note filing.
- Trades and small shops: estimate drafts, invoice chasing, supplier price-watch, scheduling, voicemail-to-CRM, and end-of-day rollups.
